quests.title: The Wayfarer Trials
quests.summary: Examiner Odile Marsh's Trial Ledger: ten tests of a wayfarer. Each one is a different kind of task, so finishing the ledger means you have tried a bit of everything.

trials.description: Complete every line of the Trial Ledger, in any order.

objectives.text: Beat the Guild sparring golem (Guildhall, Brindle Ford).
Open the Guild practice lockbox (pick it, or talk Odile out of the key).
Win someone over with words: persuade or deceive them.
Search somewhere and find something hidden.
Buy something from a merchant.
Make or improve something: drop two materials on a toolkit in your bag (a workbench opens), use the Craft tab, or drop one item on another (a whetstone on a blade).
Pass a hands-on challenge: stalk hares, cast the augury bones, grind a remedy at rest, or strike the anvil.
Answer the Bog Stone's riddle in the Old Moss.
Travel with a companion (hire Marta, rescue Pip, or make a deal with Jory).
Make camp for the night in the wild and live to tell of it.

report.description: The ledger is full. Take it back to Odile in the Guildhall.

objectives.text: Hand the Trial Ledger to Examiner Odile Marsh.

completed.description: You are a licensed Wayfarer of the Guild.

objectives.text: You are a licensed Wayfarer of the Guild.

onNpcDeath.reason: Examiner Odile Marsh is dead. There is no one left to sign your ledger.

quests.title: Lanternfall
quests.summary: The lighthouse on Gull Rock went dark a month ago and the sea fog has been creeping inland ever since. Find out why, get across to the rock, and relight the lantern.

ask_around.description: Ask Captain Garrow at the Watch House what happened to the lighthouse.

objectives.text: Ask Captain Garrow about the dark lighthouse.

reach_rock.description: Get across to Gull Rock. Push a boat into the sea at Saltreed Cove, bargain with the smugglers, or find the cliff stair on Thornback Ridge.

objectives.text: Find a way across to Gull Rock.
Set foot on Gull Rock.

open_door.description: Get into the lighthouse: Garrow's key, the spare in the Sunken Chapel, or a very good lockpick.

objectives.text: Open the lighthouse door.

the_keeper.description: Something is down in the flooded bell chamber. Deal with it.

objectives.text: Defeat the Drowned Keeper.

relight.description: Carry the Everflame up to the lantern room and relight it.

objectives.text: Relight the Gull Rock lantern.

completed.description: The lantern burns. Lanternfall is over.

objectives.text: The lantern burns. Lanternfall is over.

onNpcDeath.narrative: With Captain Garrow dead, nobody will tell you anything. But his logbook mentions Gull Rock, and his belt carries the lighthouse key.

quests.title: Stranded on Thornback
quests.summary: Pip Tallow, the lamplighter's apprentice, is stuck on a ledge on Thornback Ridge and a storm is coming in.

earlyCompletionBonus.narrative: You got Pip down before the storm even broke!

timeMilestones.narrative: Black clouds pile up over Thornback Ridge. The storm is close. (Pip is still on the ledge.)
The storm hits Thornback. Pip has left the ledge and crawled into the caves to shelter. Finding them will be harder now.
Two days and no sign of Pip. The search is called off.

reach_pip.description: Get to Pip's ledge on Thornback Ridge: climb down, or lower a rope.

objectives.text: Reach Pip on the ledge.

pip_cave.description: The storm drove Pip into the caves on Thornback Ridge. Search for them.

objectives.text: Find Pip in the storm caves.

escort.description: Bring Pip home to Brindle Ford.

objectives.text: Bring Pip back to Brindle Ford.

report_rescue.description: Tell Captain Garrow that Pip is safe.

objectives.text: Tell Captain Garrow that Pip is home.

completed.description: Pip is home, and has decided you are the best person alive.

objectives.text: Pip is home, and has decided you are the best person alive.

quests.title: The Thing in the Old Moss
quests.summary: Captain Garrow has posted a bounty on a fogback lurker that has been dragging goats into the Old Moss.

hunt.description: Find and kill the fogback lurker in the Old Moss.

objectives.text: Slay the fogback lurker.

claim.description: Claim the bounty from Captain Garrow.

objectives.text: Collect the bounty from Captain Garrow.
Bounty paid.

quests.title: The Honey Thief
quests.summary: Something has been raiding the Willowmere hives. Sister Bramble suspects a bristle bear from Thornback Ridge.

stop_bear.description: Deal with the bristle bear on Thornback Ridge.

objectives.text: Stop the bristle bear raiding the hives.

tell_bramble.description: Tell Sister Bramble the hives are safe.

objectives.text: Report to Sister Bramble.

completed.description: The hives are safe and the Sisters are grateful.

objectives.text: The hives are safe and the Sisters are grateful.

quests.title: Honey for the Quill
quests.summary: Tamsin Quill needs a crate of Willowmere honey picked up from Sister Bramble.

fetch.description: Collect the honey crate from Sister Bramble at Willowmere.

objectives.text: Collect the honey crate from Sister Bramble.

deliver.description: Carry the crate back to Tamsin at the Quill & Candle.

objectives.text: Deliver the honey to Tamsin Quill.

completed.description: The honey is on Tamsin's shelves.

objectives.text: The honey is on Tamsin's shelves.

onNpcDeath.reason: Tamsin Quill is dead. Nobody is waiting for the honey now.

quests.title: The Saltreed Arrangement
quests.summary: Jory Vane runs the smuggling in Saltreed Cove, and the Watch would love to know it. Jory would rather you didn't tell them.

heroic.label: Turn Jory over to the Watch

pragmatic.label: Take Jory's money, keep quiet, and get a ride to Gull Rock

decide.description: Decide what to do about Jory Vane.

objectives.text: Settle things with Jory Vane.

completed.description: The Saltreed arrangement is settled, one way or another.

objectives.text: The Saltreed arrangement is settled, one way or another.

quests.title: The Stone That Asks
quests.summary: Grandmother Rook says the Bog Stone asks every traveller the same riddle, and that a causeway rises for whoever answers.

answer.description: Answer the Bog Stone's riddle in the Old Moss.

objectives.text: Answer the Bog Stone.

completed.description: The Bog Stone has been answered and the causeway to the Sunken Chapel has risen.

objectives.text: The Bog Stone has been answered and the causeway to the Sunken Chapel has risen.
